Lightweight graphical browser (Debian 13 + TigerVNC + Firefox-ESR) on the VNC console for reaching lab device web UIs. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-browser); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

Web-based packet capture (tcpdump/tshark) with a live packet table and direct .pcap download, shown in the html5 console. Replaces the VNC Wireshark. Used by the link Capture action. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-capture-web); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

Unified AAA server (FreeRADIUS + Shrubbery TACACS+ + rsyslog) in one Debian container, configured by a web GUI served on the http console. Replaces hand-editing the three separate AAA nodes. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-aaa); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

Network services appliance: DNS + DHCP + TFTP (dnsmasq), NTP (chrony, works airgapped), ZTP file serving, and an HTTP/HTTPS test endpoint with a GUI-configurable color/heading page for LB/NAT/policy labs. Web admin GUI on the console (admin/pnet). Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-services); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

NetFlow v5/v9, IPFIX and sFlow collector (goflow2) with a web GUI: live flow table, 5m/1h top talkers (sources, destinations, conversations, applications), per-exporter stats with sampling and sequence-gap estimates. In-memory flow store — no database. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-flowlab); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

Full LibreNMS SNMP NMS in one container (MariaDB + Redis + dispatcher + snmptrapd + syslog-ng built in). Web UI on the http console, login admin/pnet. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-librenms); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

Browser IDE for network automation: code-server (VS Code) + Python stack (netmiko, nornir, napalm, scrapli, textfsm) + private Gitea git server, on the HTTP console. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-netdevops); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

RPKI Validator for BGP origin validation labs: web GUI ROA editor feeding a local StayRTR server (RPKI-to-Router, RFC 8210, tcp/3323). 100% offline — no TALs, no internet. Includes rtrdump for verifying the served VRPs. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-rpki); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

ExaBGP 4.2 route injector + looking glass for BGP labs: announce/withdraw single routes with full attributes (AS-path, MED, local-pref, communities), bulk CSV / sequential-prefix generation up to 10k routes, and a live received-routes looking glass. Web admin GUI on the console (admin/pnet). Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-exabgp); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

Multicast video tester for IGMP/PIM/SSM labs — up to 4 ffmpeg test-pattern senders (h264/MPEG-TS to udp://<group>) plus a GUI-owned ASM/SSM receiver with exact TS continuity-counter loss stats, gap events, and a live browser video preview. Use two nodes across a PIM network: one sends, one receives. Web GUI on the http console (admin/pnet). Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-mcast); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

Samba Active Directory Domain Controller (LDAP / Kerberos / DNS / SMB) with a first-boot provisioning wizard on the http console. Real directory backend for 802.1X/EAP + LDAP integration labs (pairs with the AAA Suite node). The Startup-config blob rebuilds the whole domain — realm, users, groups — on a fresh container. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-adlab); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

Asterisk PBX (chan_pjsip) with two WebRTC browser softphones (SIP.js) on the https console, classic SIP udp/5060 endpoints for CME/router labs, test numbers (600 echo / 601 MOH / 602 tone / 603 announcement) and live per-call RTP loss/jitter/MOS stats — the companion node for netem WAN-impairment QoS labs. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-voip); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

Firewall security-profile test bench (vendor-neutral: Palo Alto + FortiGate). ATTACKER mode: 18 scapy L2/L3 attack/recon modules (ARP spoof/MITM, MAC spoof, CAM flood, rogue DHCP, DHCP starvation, STP root hijack, CDP/LLDP flood, DTP trunk hop, 802.1Q double-tag hop, HSRP/VRRP hijack, OSPF/EIGRP rogue adjacency, IPv6 RA/DHCPv6 spoof), each paired with the exact config that defeats it; plus an NGFW Tests group that fires traffic AT a next-gen firewall toward a server behind it so students watch the matching security profile block it live — security policy/App-ID, Antivirus (EICAR), URL filtering, Anti-Spyware/DNS + DGA, Vulnerability/IPS, File Blocking (by magic-byte file type), Data Filtering/DLP over HTTP/SMTP/FTP, SSL Decryption (a cert zoo of expired/self-signed/wrong-host/untrusted-root certs + a TLS connection analyzer), recon port scans (SYN/Xmas/…), and Zone/DoS protection — each card shows both the PA and FortiGate config and which log to watch. A Set-Target page gives eth1 an L3 identity and runs a reachability preflight; scenario chains sequence several attacks in one click; an opt-in read-only Panorama page pulls the firewall's Threat/URL/Data/WildFire logs back into the UI to close the loop. VICTIM mode turns the node into a deliberately-vulnerable target behind the firewall (SQLi/XSS/injection sims dumping fake test PII, EICAR + typed-file downloads, upload + SMTP/FTP DLP sinks) so a second Security Bench in attacker mode produces real cause→effect. The victim runs jailed as an unprivileged user bound to eth1 only. All attacks are hard-locked to the lab NIC (eth1) — never eth0/mgmt — and disabled when eth1 is absent. Web admin GUI on the console (admin/pnet). For ISOLATED lab use only. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-secbench); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

Model-driven streaming telemetry teaching node: gnmic dial-in gNMI SUBSCRIBE against OpenConfig targets (IOS-XR/NX-OS/cEOS/SR Linux) with live Interfaces/BGP/System dashboards and a raw event-JSON stream tail, plus a real MQTT broker (Mosquitto) and Kafka-API broker (Redpanda, best-effort) fed by gnmic outputs -- both with live GUI tabs. Optional gnmic dial-out LISTEN toggle (upstream currently Nokia SR OS-only; SUBSCRIBE is the primary, fully-general workflow). Web admin GUI on the console (admin/pnet). Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-telemetry); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

The real Yersinia layer-2 attack tool, driven from its native GTK GUI in the browser console (rendered over VNC). Covers the classic L2 attacks Yersinia is known for -- STP (root takeover, TCN, conf-BPDU flood), CDP flood, DHCP (rogue server, address starvation), DTP trunk negotiation, HSRP active-router hijack, 802.1Q, VTP (including delete-all-VLANs), and MPLS -- each launched against a lab segment on the lab NIC. Complements the Security Bench scapy node by being the actual, familiar tool with attacks scapy does not cover (VTP, MPLS). Attacks belong on the lab interface (eth1) ONLY, never eth0 (management/console); the GUI defaults its interface to eth1 and shows an isolated-lab-only warning on start. The lab platform assigns eth1's IP (right-click node > network settings). For ISOLATED lab use only -- this tool sends real, disruptive attack frames. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-yersinia); loads the bundled image store copy when present.
Open-source FRRouting Docker node with BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RIP, PIM and BFD routing protocols.

Azure Region Simulator docker node: VNets, NSGs, UDRs, VNet Peering, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute, driven from a web admin GUI on the http console. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-azure); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

AWS Region Simulator docker node: VPC, subnets, route tables, security groups/NACLs, Internet/NAT gateways, Transit Gateway, Site-to-Site VPN and Direct Connect, with multi-region support, driven from a web admin GUI on the http console. Pulls from Docker Hub (rspnet/pnet-aws); loads the bundled image store copy when present.

Independent LTM learning simulator with real HAProxy traffic processing, TCP/HTTP health monitors, member-level balancing, priority groups, and persistence. Web console on the HTTP node console (admin/pnet). Pulls the verified final rspnet/pnet-ltm build by immutable Docker Hub digest.
device_script:
EXPECTED='sha256:2a3a4a1bd48937a2cd7d80eb1517d6f1932071556e1d686eb457655eee3213c2'
IMAGE='rspnet/pnet-ltm@sha256:2c524dc1fa8c517ee7f9c35409f044bb2195db867ebd287abd69927f99b2d87a'
F=/opt/unetlab/addons/docker-store/pnet-ltm-1-0.tar.gz
LOCAL_OK=0
if [ -f "$F" ]; then
  echo "Loading pnet-ltm:1.0 from local image store..."
  docker load -i "$F"; RC=$?
  if [ "$RC" = "0" ]; then
    GOT=$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' pnet-ltm:1.0 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$GOT" = "$EXPECTED" ]; then
      echo "Offline image config matches the verified final build."
      LOCAL_OK=1
    else
      echo "Offline image is not the verified final build; using the pinned Docker Hub image."
      docker rmi pnet-ltm:1.0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
  fi
fi
if [ "$LOCAL_OK" != "1" ]; then
  echo "Pulling the verified final LTM build from Docker Hub by manifest digest..."
  docker pull "$IMAGE"; RC=$?
  if [ "$RC" = "0" ]; then
    GOT=$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$IMAGE" 2>/dev/null); RC=$?
    if [ "$RC" = "0" ] && [ "$GOT" = "$EXPECTED" ]; then
      docker tag "$GOT" pnet-ltm:1.0; RC=$?
    else
      echo "Pulled LTM image config does not match the verified final build."
      RC=1
    fi
  fi
fi
GOT=$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' pnet-ltm:1.0 2>/dev/null)
if [ "$GOT" = "$EXPECTED" ]; then
  echo "Done. pnet-ltm:1.0 matches $EXPECTED."
else
  echo "FAILED to load the verified pnet-ltm:1.0 image (rc=$RC)"
  RC=1
fi
mysql pnetlab_db -e "DELETE FROM process_device WHERE process_device_id='{device_id}'"
device_delete:
echo "Removing pnet-ltm:1.0..."
docker rmi pnet-ltm:1.0 2>/dev/null || true
docker rmi rspnet/pnet-ltm@sha256:2c524dc1fa8c517ee7f9c35409f044bb2195db867ebd287abd69927f99b2d87a 2>/dev/null || true
mysql pnetlab_db -e "DELETE FROM process_device WHERE process_device_id='{device_id}'"
